notes: Full lifecycle confirmed: add item to UNSENT invoice → delete item by order index. The path parameter 'order' is 1-based integer, NOT a MongoDB-style id. The invoice items list API shows id='' (empty string) and invoiceItemId='' for all items — items have no standalone ID. Our spec correctly uses 'order' as path param. The ADD response returns the full invoice object (not just the item). A key finding: item_type must match a workspace-configured invoice item type name exactly — 'Service' was rejected with 404 'Invoice item type with name Service not found'; the actual item type in this workspace is 'Serviceasd'. The MCP tool descriptor says item_type is 'required by the Clockify API' and lists it as a free-form string, which is correct.
